title: Vizhnitzer Rebbe Heads Stateside
body: Vizhnitzer Rebbe to travel to US for granddaughters' weddings in Skver and Monsey, amid chassidus instructions to chassidim.

title: Yemenite Shul Vandalized
body: Unknown perpetrators desecrated a Yemenite shul in Kadima-Tzoran, vandalizing Sifrei Torah, tearing seforim, and causing widespread destruction.

title: Singer Menachem Mendel Luk Passes
body: Menachem Mendel Luk, a 55-year-old singer from the Sanzer community, has passed away after suffering a severe stroke at Ichilov Hospital in Tel Aviv.
